SelectField: A labelled drop-down of choices, bound to a data-model path. options is a list of {value, label} (literal, or bound to a list in the data). Must be inside a Form.
CardList: The phone-friendly list: one card per record. Use instead of DataTable on phone moments. rows binds to an array in the data model; title is the field shown as each card's heading; lines are further fields shown under it (format: text, money, date); badge shows one field as a status word, with tones mapping value to neutral, info, success, warning or danger.
Column: Stacks its children vertically. The usual root of a screen.
Row: Lays its children side by side; wraps on narrow screens. Children share the width equally.
Heading: A heading. Use size xl for the screen's title (one per screen).
Text: A paragraph. muted for secondary text such as a screen's one-line explanation.
Card: A bordered panel with an optional title; groups related content. tone colors the border: warning or danger for "needs attention" groups.
Stat: One headline number with a label, e.g. "Customers 42". format money expects {minorUnits, currency}. Put each Stat in its own Card inside a Row.
Button: A button. Its action is an event the app handles (name it as a verb: saveCustomer, sendInvoice).
DataTable: A paged, sortable table of records. rows binds to an array in the data model; each column shows one field. format: date for ISO dates (yyyy-mm-dd), money for {minorUnits, currency}, badge for a short status word. tones colors badges by value: {"Unassigned": "warning", "Done": "success"} (neutral, info, success, warning, danger).
Form: Holds input fields and the button that saves them. Every InputField must be inside a Form.
InputField: A labelled text input bound to a data-model path. serverError binds to where the app writes the server's message for this field. @checks are the field's rules (required, email, regex, length), each with the message to show.
